item.title: [MEDIUM] Malaysian police tie five deepfake videos of Anwar, Trump, Musk and Petronas to scam
item.description: Bukit Aman's commercial crime unit said one syndicate made five deepfake videos of PM Anwar, Donald Trump, Elon Musk, Petronas executives and MP Teresa Kok promoting a fake government-backed scheme with 100x returns. Target: Malaysian retail investors. MY. Verification: confirmed.
